records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE landscape character catalogue sheet, target 1536x1024, THREE full-body PLAYER CHARACTERS for the fictional Korean dark fantasy ARPG Joseon Hunters. Title "K2-A". Small column labels left to right "A-D / DOHO", "A-G / GWISAE", "A-C / CHEONGYEON".

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. The K2 sheet is the strict STYLE anchor. Its understated Korean manhwa faces, confident fine ink outlines, broad matte painted shadows, human adult anatomy, muted dark palette and quiet grey inspection background must apply to ALL THREE characters. The leftmost Doho is also his identity reference. Do not include its NPCs.
2. Gwisae identity ONLY from the MIDDLE G02 column. Do not copy the other variants, dense patterns, realistic rendering, white background or ornate jewelry.
3. Cheongyeon identity ONLY from LEFT C01. Retain identifiers, but redraw into the K2 style and simplify ornament to the same detail level as Doho.

VARIANT A — restrained and practical. These three should look like they could walk into the SAME village as K2's merchant, shaman and elder. They are not glossy mobile-game heroes. Coherent Korean cultural design through narrow white dongjeong collars, cloth goreum ties, po/jeogori shapes, generous baji, gat/manggeon, Korean gaksi mask, compact jokduri-like headpiece, fabric knots. Plain matte cloth with a few decisive folds. Long clear color masses consistent with stylized game models. Dark fantasy palette and character wit retained. Natural individually drawn Korean adult faces, reduced heroic brow/jaw exaggeration, no racial caricature or template face.

Layout: three evenly spaced figures, complete headgear, soles and held props visible with generous margins. Facing front or slight three-quarter, calm standing inspection poses. Same ground baseline; comparable human scale. Sword and fan must stay inside their own columns. Optional small facial-detail inset above each figure ONLY if it does not crowd full silhouettes; otherwise omit insets. Plain dark neutral charcoal-grey backdrop. Soft neutral inspection lighting, faces readable, no magical VFX or scene lighting.

A-D DOHO: late-20s Korean male wandering swordsman. Slim relaxed body, CLEAN-SHAVEN, warm sly eyes and a small unforced grin like K2. No beard, moustache or scarf. Black hair tied beneath a fine black manggeon and black Korean heukrip/gat: wide thin nearly horizontal brim, cylindrical crown, tiny dull blue circular badge, modest bead strings. Large deep navy after-dyed dopo, slim ivory dongjeong at curved crossed collar, roomy rounded sleeves, plain dark wrist cuffs, straight hanging panels split enough to see charcoal loose trousers. Modest dull brick-red cloth sash, small blue round waist charm, dark practical boots. Straight sword loosely held downward in his right hand, entire blade and tip visible. Simple dark scabbard on opposite hip. Broad quiet fabric surfaces.

A-G GWISAE: adult Korean woman around 27, lean athletic but natural build, grounded light-footed stance. Long black HIGH PONYTAIL. Wears the ivory Korean GAKSI TAL mask from G02: human smiling carved features, a red circle on forehead and each cheek, calm narrow eye slits, no horns or fangs, not a Japanese oni/kitsune mask. A few restrained red hair ties. Short BLACK split outer coat with narrow dull crimson edges, subdued deep PURPLE inner jeogori and white narrow collar, plain black loose baji and matte boots. Sleeves gathered practically near wrists; front cloth ties rather than armor buckles. One curved short DAGGER low in her right hand and one long faded crimson ribbon accent. Exactly TWO small spare wooden masks secured side by side at her anatomical LEFT hip (viewer right); their faces unobstructed, no third spare mask and no floating mask. Preserve G02's trouser silhouette and agility. No dense red floral embroidery, metal pauldrons or leather corset.

A-C CHEONGYEON: adult Korean woman around 29, serene observant expression and natural understated face; same face drawing and matte skin treatment as Doho. Long black hair with two slim braids. Compact BLACK-and-antique-brass Korean ceremonial headpiece shaped like a small jokduri, not a towering crown; minimal pin and one small jade accent. Worn IVORY and pale grey-CELADON long Korean ceremonial hanbok: narrow dongjeong and a modest visible goreum, broad rounded sleeves, long quiet draping panels over high-waisted full skirt. Keep the light clothing identity but grade it to worn bone and grey jade, never luminous pure white. One small restrained dull-gold bird motif near lower hem, otherwise plain cloth. OPEN black folding fan with sparse subtle star markings in one hand; modest brass bell cluster in the other. One jade waist ornament and two short paper seals, no cascade of jewels. Simple muted shoes. No long fantasy obi, glitter, delicate photographic lace, luminous eyes or magical glow.

Rendering invariants: coherent K2 ink-and-matte-paint, muted navy/black/purple/bone/celadon with small worn crimson/antique brass accents, no all-over brocade, NO harsh colored rim lights, glossy skin or PBR metal. All ages adult. Mature game character design, not chibi, fashion editorial, photorealism, oil portraiture or high-saturation anime. Background simple and dark but bodies readable. This is a catalogue exploration, not a screenshot, T-pose technical sheet or combat illustration.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE 1536x1024 landscape GUMIHO before-and-after transformation character catalogue for Joseon Hunters. Title "K2-A". Small labels "A-F1 / HUMAN" and "A-F3 / REVEALED". Two full-body depictions of the SAME adult Korean woman. This is the restrained A variation, matching the supplied K2-A player trio.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1 K2 is the primary drawing/style anchor: mature restrained Korean manhwa faces, fine confident ink contours, broad matte painted shading, readable anatomy, neutral dark grey backdrop. Match its NPCs' medium and level of stylization; do not depict those NPCs.
2 Identity catalogue: ONLY LEFT F01 is human form, ONLY RIGHT F03 is revealed form. Ignore middle F02 entirely. Preserve black hair, amber-gold eyes, adult woman identity, red hanbok and restrained golden motifs, small dagger in F01, nine golden tails in F03. Its old bright background, intricate pattern density and glossy face rendering are not style references.
3 Newly made K2-A players establishes compatible line, skin, fabric shading and subdued value ranges. Gumiho belongs to precisely the same game and illustrator.

A DIRECTION: composed, restrained Korean tale figure, elegant and quietly dangerous. Korean clothing structure must be obvious: slim white dongjeong along curved crossed jeogori collar, clearly tied cloth goreum at upper chest, roomy rounded sleeves, high gathered chima waistband beneath jacket, wide skirt with a few calm vertical folds, low cloth shoes and a modest knotted norigae. No cinched European corset, wrapped broad obi, fantasy armor or towering metal crown. Inspired fictional hanbok, not strict historical reconstruction. Main red is deep dried-madder/oxblood; gold is dull old brass with only a few motifs, no all-over brocade. Fur is warm muted ochre-gold and grey-cream, hand-painted in broad shapes, not glowing.

LAYOUT: Human at left 30%, revealed at right 65%, generous gutter and exterior margins. Both upright figures at same human scale, full feet visible. Give revealed form enough room for all nine tail tips, entirely inside frame. Calm standing front/slight three-quarter catalogue pose, no combat or dynamic camera. Soft neutral inspection lighting on a plain charcoal grey backdrop. No architecture, magical effects, halo, fire or props on floor.

F01 HUMAN: Korean woman around 30, long BLACK hair half pulled back with a thin brass binyeo and one small floral pin. Understated natural adult face, poised almond-shaped eyes and small knowing closed-mouth smile, no exaggerated pointed jaw or villain brows. Amber-gold irises subtle, not glowing. Same economical face rendering as Doho/Cheongyeon, not photoreal or porcelain doll. Deep muted red Korean jeogori and chima, ivory collar, visible red goreum, subdued gold motifs concentrated only at cuff and lower hem, dark red small knot pendant. Hold a SMALL straight dagger pointing down beside thigh, entirely visible. EXACTLY ZERO TAILS, no tail silhouettes, no fox ears, no animal paws.

F03 REVEALED: exactly the same face, age, skin, black hair and gold eyes. More formal deep red hanbok ensemble with a roomier outer sleeve and slightly fuller long chima. Only a few simple brass binyeo pins in the half-up dark hair; no antlers, horns, fox ears or oversized crown. Hands held calmly at waist, authority from stillness. Small restrained cuff/hem gold motifs and one longer knotted tassel. Compact upright cluster of EXACTLY NINE fox tails anchored behind lower back. Arrange tips COUNTABLY: one near top center behind head, FOUR spaced down the left side and FOUR spaced down the right side. Each of the nine fluffy tapering tails has a single distinct tip and a visible separation from neighbors; roots may be behind torso. Compact oval fan, dignified rather than huge blinding wings. Tail tips do not overlap the human form. Use simple tuft masses with low-contrast edges, NO luminous gold rays.

Entire image shares K2's quiet human expressions and broad matte color blocks. Maintain dark fantasy mood without crushing faces to black or tinting skin grey. Dark navy-neutral shadows, oxblood cloth, dirty ivory collars, sparse antique brass and muted golden fur. No bright daytime glamour, saturated red silk gloss, realistic pores, dense costume filigree, anime sparkles, European regalia, additional characters, intermediate transformation or extra small tail studies. Only two full-body forms and the specified small labels.

records.prompt:
Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 character-design comparison sheet: THREE distinct lead-hero designs of DOHO, the same clean-shaven adult Korean wandering swordsman. Title "K2 / DOHO". Column labels "H1", "H2", "H3". All three must clearly look like a playable protagonist, not a plain village NPC.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1, leftmost Doho, supplies identity and current K2 drawing style. The user says this design is too ordinary/NPC-like. Substantially redesign his garment shapes and hero presence while retaining identity, NOT just relight the same figure. Other two characters are style neighbors only, do not depict them.
Image 2 is K2 NPC context. Match the same Korean manhwa line, mature face treatment, matte brush shading and world palette, but give Doho stronger shape hierarchy and a recognizable signature. NPCs keep workaday closed silhouettes; Doho must have a distinct athletic, open, asymmetric swordsman silhouette even standing still.

COMMON IDENTITY: late-20s adult Korean male, lean athletic rather than huge muscular body, appealing confident sly eyes and tiny knowing half smile, CLEAN-SHAVEN, black hair under a black Korean heukrip/gat with thin wide nearly horizontal brim and cylindrical crown, fine manggeon band, ONE small blue crown badge, restrained bead cords. Deep navy/indigo Korean dopo, off-white narrow dongjeong, dull cinnabar red waist cloth, one round blue waist charm, straight slender sword and dark scabbard, charcoal baji, matte black boots. NO scarf, moustache, beard, oversized fantasy sword, horns, western armor, fur cape or added crown.

HERO DESIGN RULES: preserve unmistakable curved crossed Korean collar and cloth closures. Strengthen shoulder-to-waist-to-hem rhythm through garment cut, not exaggerated anatomy. 3-4 BIG legible color and cloth shapes, clear waist anchor, readable separate legs and sword. Give face/upper chest the strongest local value contrast with the ivory collar against navy; navy can be a little richer than NPC grey-brown but the world stays DARK. More decisive eye contact and confident body weight. Simple iconic sword fitting with tiny dull-brass/blue accent, not filigree. Avoid repeated decorative texture. The three variations differ in CUT, LAYERING and SILHOUETTE so the change survives neutral light and a game idle pose. Same rendering and physical character size in all three; no colored rim lighting, halos, magic or scene staging to fake protagonism.

H1 — witty swordsman: a dynamic clean short-over-long Korean dopo cut, front upper layer ends slightly above knees and opens into two broad sharp falling navy panels, darker calf-length rear layer. Narrow off-white inner collar extends in a clear V without becoming a scarf. Red waist tie is firm and has two medium asymmetrical tails. Visible charcoal baji from mid-thigh below open split, planted boots, relaxed bend in one knee. Right hand rests a straight sword over one shoulder at a contained diagonal; full blade visible inside his own column. Left hand at waist. Slight body lean, raised chin, small playful grin. Signature: triangle of brim/shoulders, narrow red waist, open athletic lower silhouette. Cloth matte, zero embroidery.

H2 — composed exorcist swordsman: somewhat longer overlapping Korean po layers, a broad deep-indigo outer shoulder/sleeve silhouette over charcoal-blue inner robe, clean angular opening showing the white collar. One fitted cloth waist knot and ONE round blue medallion form the visual center. Two short aged paper seals tucked into belt as CONSUMABLE EQUIPMENT, no supernatural powers or spell glow. One forward knee parts the long straight outer panels, dark trousers clearly visible. Both hands in a calm sword-ready posture, one lightly resting on the hilt of a long dark scabbard angled beside the body; blade mostly sheathed. More steady confident gaze than H1, dignified but still young and clever. Korean garment layers, NO chest armor, pauldrons, shield or monk beads. Signature: strong wide upper silhouette and commanding central vertical, large quiet cloth fields.

H3 — legendary wandering swordsman: elegant long divided navy-blue dopo with slightly longer side/back panels flowing into TWO broad curved cloth shapes, not many narrow ribbons. A small area of faded lighter blue inner sleeve/lining visible to separate shapes. Off-white dongjeong frames face, rich muted red diagonal waist tie with one longer clearly visible tail, blue charm at knot. Forearms gently gathered in dark cuffs, free hand loosely near hat brim without hiding face, other hand holding straight sword lowered obliquely; full blade clear. One foot forward, long relaxed S-line in the body, confident direct look and subtle smirk. Modern Korean historical action-manhwa lead presence without idol makeup. Signature: long sweeping outer contour broken by visible knees and boots, not a closed scholar's cylinder. No cape, scarf or luxurious brocade.

COMPOSITION: Three full-body figures occupying equal columns with generous gutters and 5% margins. All hat brims, scabbards, swords, cloth ends and soles completely in frame. Similar eye-level slight three-quarter catalogue views, same ground line and body height. No scenic backgrounds, portrait boxes or NPC silhouettes. Soft neutral inspection light, simple dark grey backdrop, small contact shadows. Same fine confident K2 ink lines and broad matte painterly shading on every variant, naturally differentiated fabric folds, unglossy skin. Deep navy, charcoal, dirty ivory, limited dark red and muted blue; mature Korean dark fantasy. Make each hero outfit visibly different from the starting plain Doho while retaining his Korean identity and practical stylized 3D readability.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE 1536x1024 landscape protagonist character sheet titled "K2-D / R1". The user specifically requests borrowing the OLD D03 costume because the recent stripped-down K2 protagonist looked like an ordinary NPC. Restore that distinctive costume design while KEEPING the K2 Korean drawing style. This must read as the main playable hero of a Korean dark fantasy action RPG.

REFERENCE HIERARCHY:
IMAGE 1 K2: STYLE ONLY, and leftmost Doho's natural clean-shaven adult Korean face type. Fine confident Korean manhwa line, mature understated facial construction, broad matte hand-painted shadows, grey inspection backdrop and muted game-compatible palette. Do NOT use this image's plain protagonist costume, that is the rejected aspect. Do not depict the NPCs.
IMAGE 2 old D03 master: PRIMARY COSTUME AND POSE source. Clearly carry over its layered navy dopo, distinct wide overlapping sleeves, long divided outer panels, curved cloud/pine/crane hem embroidery, circular upper-sleeve seal, blue round waist disc with tassel, bead hatstrings, original black heukrip and straight sword resting over a shoulder. Its older glossy pretty-boy rendering is NOT the style guide.
IMAGE 3 catalogue: ONLY rightmost D03 is approved identity. Ignore D01 and D02. Preserve D03's navy/black/off-white/dull red/blue balance, lean swordsman body and confident witty presence.

LAYOUT: a large full-body Doho filling left two-thirds and a larger head-and-upper-chest portrait at upper right. At lower right show two small clearly separated material/prop details copied from what he ACTUALLY WEARS: the circular upper-sleeve motif and the round blue waist medallion. Small labels "D03 COSTUME / K2 STYLE", "SLEEVE", "WAIST" if needed; no other text. No scenic backdrop, UI or magic. Full hat brim, entire sword tip, both boots, all long garment hems inside the frame with generous margins. No overlap between full figure and detail portraits.

COSTUME TO RESTORE IN CLEAR BIG READABLE SHAPES:
- Black Korean heukrip with a thin wide flat horsehair brim, straight cylindrical crown, low restrained antique-gold patterned hat band and blue circular badge. Black manggeon underneath. Two modest blue-and-brass bead strings end at chest, not many jewelry chains.
- Rich dark NAVY outer dopo over charcoal navy inner layers, ivory curved dongjeong collar. Broad layered draped sleeves over fitted dark forearm cuffs with simple dull brass binding lines. The folded sleeve silhouette must feel deliberately designed for a lead character.
- Navy outer coat falls to lower calf and divides into two wide front panels plus broader rear/side panels. One side is gently swept outward, creating the iconic asymmetry of original D03. Show black loose baji, knees and boots through the front opening; no closed scholar-robe cylinder, skirt or modern pants.
- Dull brick-red cloth waist sash with long distinct ends, original round muted BLUE brass-framed disc at one hip with short blue tassel. Disc large enough to read as a signature at game size but not a shield. One slim worn charm strip permitted, not a clutter of bells/chains.
- Borrow the original D03's circular astronomical/seal motif on ONE upper sleeve and a few larger pale antique-gold line drawings of a pine branch and crane/cloud group at one lower side hem. Group these into TWO OR THREE clear motif areas. Leave chest, most sleeves and most skirt panels as quiet dark matte cloth. These motifs must be visible but subdued, not all-over floral wallpaper.
- Black functional boots with restrained ties, slim straight Korean fantasy sword with a recognizable dark-and-brass hilt and ONE blue cord/tassel, plain dark scabbard securely hung at opposite hip. No Western armor, pauldrons, long fur cloak, extra crown, huge metal jewelry or scarf.

FACE AND HERO PRESENCE: same adult man about 28, clean-shaven with NO moustache or chin beard. Distinct Korean historical-manhwa lead, natural mature eyes and jaw, a knowing asymmetric small smile, confident attentive gaze. Not an idol beauty portrait, teenage anime boy, or exaggerated Western comic hero. Character is witty and relaxed rather than grim. Slightly stronger face/ivory collar contrast than the NPCs gives a focal point without boosting global brightness. His clean eye shapes, hat silhouette, layered coat and signature blue disc must create recognizability.

POSE AND ANATOMY: relaxed planted swordsman stance, one knee naturally flexed, balanced hips and modest three-quarter torso. Right hand naturally grips the sword HILT with a coherent thumb and curled fingers, the blade rests at a safe oblique line over his right shoulder behind the neck, not slicing through head/hat. The complete straight blade and tip stay in the left full-body area. Left hand rests casually on the top of the hanging scabbard or waist. Exactly two arms/two hands/two legs. Do not invent extra blades or duplicate hilts. Portrait duplicates EXACTLY the same face, hat and collar arrangement, not a second design.

RENDERING: unambiguously K2 across face and whole costume: fine ink contours, broad matte brush planes, warm natural restrained skin, quiet navy cloth, muted red ties, sparse antique brass and blue accents. No photoreal pores, glossy satin, jewelry sparkle, glow, rim-light, haze or cinematic backlight. Korean dark fantasy, richly designed protagonist against plain dark grey backdrop. Hero distinction must survive neutral illumination and remain visible in clothing shapes, not only in pose or precious decorations. This is a visual candidate for review, not an in-game render or a technical turnaround.
